description: The abstraction under which this package's results hold. It is NOT the operational domain: no simulator, no continuous dynamics, no real geometry and no capture contract are present.

time.representation: continuous real-valued arrival times within finite unions of closed intervals
time.note: The operational 0.1 s step, 1 s decision interval and 300 s horizon are contract values fixed at W2/W3. They play no role here.

geometry.lane_model: one usable scalar length per lane; stations are counted, not placed
geometry.swept_body_model: NOT IMPLEMENTED; movement conflicts are declared, not computed
geometry.note: Body width 1.8 m and orientation are part of the operational contract and are not used by this abstraction.

arrival_model.implemented: set algebra over canonical unions with a mandatory approximation-direction label
arrival_model.not_implemented: any procedure that DERIVES arrival sets from a road network, traffic state or vehicle dynamics
arrival_model.consequence_recorded: On the only arrival model this programme has measured (historical obligation O28), free-flow lane estimates are lower bounds with no attainable upper bound under interaction, which makes the derived sets OVER-approximations. Under Rule A such sets can never yield SUPPORTED.

evader_model.implemented: declared branch identifiers and a coverage fraction
evader_model.not_implemented: any evader policy, continuation rule or route model

capture_contract.dwell_values_used_here: per-case illustrative values in configs/finite_examples_v1.json; they are NOT the operational dwell_time_s

team.note: Case sizes were chosen so that every answer is exhaustively checkable by hand.

not_represented: lane change, signal and junction behaviour
